lines.text: She smiled, then insulted my hat!
She threw shade at my new hat.

data.define: To insult someone in a sneaky, indirect way.

example.text: She threw shade at my new hat.

misuse.text: Don't say 'throw shade' about a tree's shadow.

hook.text: She smiled, then insulted my hat!

publish.title: What does "throw shade" mean?
publish.value: Throw shade = Say something a little rude. Example: "She threw shade at my new hat." (very casual English, US).
